$comment: The signature register. A signature is a commit that adds an entry to `signatures`; see CLA.md section 11. Guarded by tools/check_cla.py and .github/workflows/cla.yml.

owner.name: Corneel den Hartogh
owner.note: The rights holder; does not sign his own CLA. Two git identities: the plain address and GitHub's private commit address. Every address here gives coverage without a signature, so it must be one the owner demonstrably holds — a placeholder on a reserved domain (example.com, RFC 2606) could be taken over by anyone with one `git config user.email`.

bots.note: Dependency bumps; no copyrightable work of a third party.
Commits from workflows in this repository.
The `Co-Authored-By:` trailer of Claude Code commits. No mailbox and no rights holder; the work is the committer's.
